title: 3.3.8d Lab — Method calling this.method
description: Add a spin() method to Planet that rotates the shape AND calls this.recolor() — one method dispatching another on the same instance.

steps.title: Add spin() that calls this.recolor()
steps.instructions: Inside the Planet class, write a `spin()` method that increments `this.shape.rotation.y += 0.05` and then calls `this.recolor()`. Both use `this.` because they operate on the same instance.
hints: Open the shplay docs drawer on the right — a method can call other methods on the same instance using `this.methodName()`.

requirements.title: spin() calls this.recolor()
requirements.description: Write spin() inside Planet. It must rotate this.shape AND call this.recolor().
